appPage.title: Official Android app
appPage.subtitle: Download the HRMP app straight from the source — no app store, no middleman. The permanent link always serves the latest release signed with the platform's key.
appPage.downloadSub: The official HRMP platform app: same account and same data, with a full 100% screen, immersive mode and native document downloads inside the app.
appPage.permanentNote: permanent link that always serves the latest release
appPage.s1b: Tap the download button from your phone's browser (Chrome or Samsung Internet) and wait for HRMP.apk to finish downloading — it shows in notifications and the download bar.
appPage.s2b: When opening the file, Android will ask to allow the download source: choose “Settings” then enable “Install unknown apps” for the browser you downloaded with (one time only).
appPage.s3b: Go back and tap “Install” — once finished, open the app from the app drawer or the download notification.
appPage.ppBody: During installation Play Protect may show an “unknown app” warning. The reason is simple: the app is distributed directly by the HRMP platform, not through the Play Store — by design (an in-house app signed with the owner's fixed key). The file is safe and comes from the official source.
appPage.pp1: When the warning appears, tap “More details”.
appPage.pp2: Choose “Install this unsafe app” — on some devices: “Install anyway”.
appPage.pp3: If the warning reappears after installation, choose “Ignore” — it won't show again for the same version.
appPage.ppReassure: Why does the warning appear? Because the app is outside the Play Store. Its signature has been fixed since 2026-10-19, its key belongs to the platform owner, and every update installs over the existing one with the same signature.
appPage.updatesTitle: Updates install over the existing app
appPage.updatesBody: Don't uninstall to update — download the new version from the same link and install it directly: the same signing key means a silent update that keeps your data and session.
appPage.accountBody: The app opens the same platform (the reference server) you use from the browser — sign in with the same email and password. If you changed your password, use the newest one on all devices.

landing.heroTitle: One platform for your human resources: from hiring to payroll
landing.heroSubtitle: For security, cleaning, gardening, construction, and crafts companies: publish your vacancies and recruit verified seekers, location-bound attendance, smart scheduling, and complete payslips under the Moroccan Labour Code — CNSS, AMO, and IR — from gross to net.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Every module follows the reference specification and integrates seamlessly
landing.featureSchedulingDesc: Recurring daily and weekly programs, rotating shifts, and ready-made sector templates: night watches for security, daytime hours for construction, multi-site distribution for cleaning — with shift-conflict prevention.
landing.featureGeofencingDesc: Check-in and check-out bound to each site's point and radius (geofencing), verified on the server rather than the app, with mock-location detection and logging of rejected attempts.
landing.featurePayrollDesc: Complete calculation in dirham (stored in cents): hours, night and rest-day overtime, deductions and bonuses, then CNSS, AMO and income tax — values held as dated data, never hard-coded constants.
landing.featureDeclarationsDesc: CNSS (Damancom) and DGI (SIMPL-IR) file generation through an accountant-reviewed approval cycle, with a versioned specification registry — no file is exported before approval.
landing.featureReportsDesc: Payslips and statements as PDF, DOCX and image, with correct Arabic fonts and full RTL, for every level: employee, supervisor, manager and owner — with a digital verification mark.
landing.featureSecurityDesc: Each company's data fully isolated, five roles always verified server-side, an audit trail for every sensitive action, and strict authentication with optional 2FA.
landing.techSubtitle: The same code runs in the cloud (Vercel + Cloudflare) and on your local server — only configuration differs
landing.techItem1Desc: Automatic deployment via GitHub/Vercel, plus a local Termux server reachable over LAN or a secure Cloudflare tunnel.
landing.techItem2Desc: Lightweight, fast SQLite for local operation, with a schema ready to upgrade to PostgreSQL as you scale.
landing.techItem3Desc: An immutable audit log: who acted, when, before/after and why — full review transparency.
landing.techItem4Desc: Arabic (RTL), French, English and Spanish — interface and reports, with no machine translation.
landing.footerRights: Platform ownership is customizable and transferable
landing.referencesSubtitle: The platform computes payroll and contributions under Moroccan legal rules — here are the official bodies and the original law texts so you can verify them yourself.
landing.refPoint1Desc: CNSS, DGI, the Ministry of Employment and the Ministry of Finance — every body where your files are filed.
landing.refPoint2Desc: The labour code and the legislative compilations for social security and AMO — to verify every applied rule.
landing.refPoint3Desc: Official PDF files available to the public from the publishers' own sites — with no dead links.
landing.featureRecruitmentDesc: Publish your project vacancies on a public page and attract registered job seekers with automated email and phone verification and an ID document authenticated by the platform administration before applying.

terms.title: HRMP Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: By using the platform you accept these terms — last updated: version {version}
terms.s1b: HRMP is a human resources management platform: publishing job vacancies and recruiting seekers, attendance with geographic verification, scheduling and coverage, wages and legal deductions, and official declarations. The service is provided "as is" to companies residing in Morocco; payroll data is governed by the Moroccan legislation in force (Labour Code No. 65-99 and its implementing regulations).
terms.s2b: The company administrator creates accounts and grants roles (employee/supervisor/accountant/admin/owner). Each user is responsible for the confidentiality of their password; every sensitive action is recorded in an immutable audit log. A permission delegation never expands beyond its original scope.
terms.s2l1: Never share your credentials, not even with a colleague.
terms.s2l2: Change your password immediately from Settings if you suspect a leak.
terms.s2l3: Financial actions (payroll approval, declarations) are documented under their author's name and are never reassigned.
terms.s3b: Using the platform for unlawful or harmful purposes, entering false attendance or payroll data, or attempting to defeat geographic verification (fake GPS, emulators…) is prohibited — all attempts are recorded technically and may expose their author to disciplinary action under labor law.
terms.s3l1: A check-in outside the defined site is rejected automatically and the tampering attempt is preserved.
terms.s3l2: Platform data must never be used to discriminate against or harm any worker.
terms.s4b: Company data (entities, shifts, payroll) belongs to that company; operational data (logs, document fingerprints) belongs to the platform owner. Deleting sensitive data never removes anything from the audit log — it is immutable by design.
terms.s5b: These terms are governed by Moroccan law: Labor Code (law 65-99), law 53-95 on electronic commerce, and law 09-08 on personal data protection. Where these terms conflict with a non-waivable right, the statute prevails.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: What we collect, why, and for how long — full transparency
privacy.s1b: We collect only what the service needs: account data (name, email, phone), attendance data (timestamps, coordinates at check-in, GPS accuracy, distance to site), in-team voice messages, and payroll/declaration data.
privacy.s1l1: Location is read only at check-in time or during an active field shift — no permanent tracking.
privacy.s1l2: Zone verification is decided by the server (site radius), not the app — it cannot be faked from the phone.
privacy.s2b: Data is processed to execute the employment contract and its legal obligations (payroll computation, CNSS/AMO contributions, official declarations) and to maintain service quality and the audit log — in accordance with law 09-08 on personal data protection.
privacy.s2l1: Your data is never sold or shared for commercial purposes.
privacy.s2l2: Sharing is limited to lawful bodies (CNSS/AMO/labor inspection) upon legitimate request.
privacy.s3b: Payroll and declaration data is retained for the legally required durations; the audit log is retained in full (immutable by design); instantaneous positions are not stored after a shift closes, except within final attendance records.
privacy.s4b: You may access and correct your data through your company administrator or the Settings page, and object to non-essential processing. Deletion requests remain subject to statutory retention periods — CNSS and inspection rights are not erased by deletion.
privacy.s4l1: To file a complaint: your company's data protection officer, then the CNDP (National Data Protection Commission).
privacy.s5b: Sessions are signed (JWT), connections encrypted (HTTPS), passwords hashed (bcrypt), and permissions enforced server-side — not just in the UI. Every sensitive action is logged with its author, time, and IP address.

safety.title: Occupational Health & Safety Conditions
safety.subtitle: A reference for workers and supervisors — based on the Moroccan Labor Code (articles 281 onward)
safety.s1b: Article 281 requires the employer to keep workplaces clean and to provide the hygiene and safety conditions necessary to protect workers' health. Article 282 requires machinery and devices to have effectiveness recognized by the competent authority without harming workers' health.
safety.s1l1: Provide personal protective equipment suited to the site (security, cleaning, landscaping…) at no cost to the worker.
safety.s1l2: Inform workers in writing of health & safety rules and of operating instructions for heavy equipment.
safety.s1l3: Any company employing 50 or more workers must establish a safety and hygiene committee (Labor Code, book II).
safety.s1l4: Breaching hygiene/safety measures is fined (up to MAD 20,000) and obstructing a labor inspector is a criminal offense.
safety.s2b: Safety is shared: the worker follows prevention instructions, uses the provided equipment, and immediately reports any hazard or accident to the supervisor. Willful failure to report may release the employer from accident liability under the Labor Code.
safety.s2l1: Never work under the influence of anything that impairs focus — the field (gates, machinery, chemicals) does not forgive.
safety.s2l2: Report every accident, however minor, from "My attendance" — documentation protects your compensation rights.
safety.s2l3: Geographic verification is an attendance tool, not a substitute for on-site safety procedures.
safety.s3b: The supervisor enforces the site's safety rules: fit-for-site assignment, equipment compliance, and stopping work under unhealthy conditions — even against the day's schedule: safety precedes shifts.
safety.s3l1: Use quick coverage to reassign a worker only after confirming their fitness for the replacement site.
safety.s4b: Work accidents are compensated under CNSS (work-accident/occupational-disease branch) — report within 48 hours and keep the medical certificate. The platform documents shift time and site, which simplifies proving the accident happened during work.

rights.title: Rights and Duties of Workers and Supervisors
rights.subtitle: A practical summary of the Moroccan Labor Code (65-99) and its figures in force — a reference, not a replacement of the official text
rights.s1b: In non-agricultural activities: 44 hours per week or 2,288 hours per year. Overtime entitles the worker to a pay premium (article 201).
rights.s1l2: On the weekly rest day: +50% daytime and +100% night — unless compensatory rest is granted (art. 201/196).
rights.s1l3: Weekly rest of at least 24 consecutive hours (Code, book II).
rights.s2b: Minimum wage for industry/commerce/liberal professions (SMIG): MAD 17.10/hour in 2025, raised to MAD 17.92/hour from January 1, 2026 — about MAD 3,423 gross monthly on a 191-hour divisor.
rights.s2l1: The platform computes payroll on a monthly hour divisor set by your company (191 by default).
rights.s2l2: A wage below this floor is an inspection offense regardless of any alleged "agreement".
rights.s3b: 2025 contributions on declared salary up to the MAD 8,000/month ceiling (96,000/year): employee share 4.29% CNSS (pension 3.96 + daily allowances 0.33) and 2.26% AMO — 6.55% total. Employer share: 15.00% CNSS (family 6.40 + pension 7.93 + allowances 0.67), 3.17% AMO and 1.60% vocational training tax.
rights.s3l1: Monthly CNSS declaration before the 28th; annual declaration (DAES) before January 31.
rights.s3l2: Late declaration: 2% penalty per month of delay.
rights.s4b: The worker earns 1.5 days per month of actual work (≈18 working days per year) after six continuous months in the company; the duration grows by 1.5 days per complete five-year period, and at contract end an indemnity is due for untaken leave.
rights.s4l1: The platform shows the worker's leave balance in their profile to ease planning.
rights.s5b: The worker carries out lawful instructions, preserves professional secrecy and work tools. The supervisor manages fairly: shift distribution without discrimination (article 9 prohibits all discrimination), respect of legal working time, and transparent attendance through the platform.
rights.s5l1: Any pay or promotion discrimination (gender, opinion, family status) is an express offense (art. 9).
rights.s5l2: The worker has the right to access their file and understand how their pay was computed — transparency is a duty, not a favor.

guide.title: Platform User Guide
guide.subtitle: Five minutes to understand everything — for every role
guide.s1b: Sign in with the account created by your company's administrator. On first access use the generated initial password — change it right away in "Settings ← My profile". The interface language switches from the selector at the top and remembers your choice.
guide.s1l1: Forgot your password? Ask the administrator to regenerate it — it shows once then is masked.
guide.s2b: "My attendance" is your hub: pick your site from the list (you must be inside its radius), then check in/out — the zone is arbitrated by the server. You see today's shift, upcoming shifts, and report an accident from attendance itself.
guide.s2l1: "My schedule" shows your upcoming shifts; "My payslips" your approved slips.
guide.s2l2: Voice messages circulate within your team only — short and field-based.
guide.s3b: You follow your team's live attendance on the map, manage shifts and templates, and use quick coverage to reassign a worker after a sudden absence. You review pending check-ins and rejected events.
guide.s3l1: Verification rules (face/zone) are configured per site under "Verification policies".
guide.s4b: Payroll is driven from "Payroll": open a monthly period, enter or import lines, then approve — approval locks the period; any change goes through a new numbered version. "Regimes & declarations" generates official CNSS documents and "Reports" exports PDF/DOCX/PNG in four languages with a verification QR.
guide.s4l1: Immutable documents: same content = same document; changed content = a new numbered version.
guide.s5b: The audit log documents every sensitive action under its author's name. Settings holds your profile and password, and for managers: company rules (hours, dual approval…). Stay safe: never share your session and sign out when leaving the device.
guide.s5l1: Official Moroccan public holidays are preloaded — automatically accounted for in payroll.

references.title: Official Moroccan references
references.subtitle: Everything the platform relies on: the official bodies where files are filed, and the law texts downloadable from their original sources. Links verified live.
references.orgsSubtitle: The official Moroccan bodies the platform exchanges with (payroll, audit, filings).
references.lawsSubtitle: Official copies available to the public on the publishers' own sites — to verify every rule the platform applies.

use.cnss: Monthly payroll declaration (DAMANCOM), employee contributions, AMO and pensions.
use.dgi: Payroll tax filing (SIMPL-IR) and tax forms.
use.emploi: Labour code, working hours, leave and paid holidays.
use.sgg: Publication of laws and decrees — the official Bulletin Officiel archive.
use.lof: Legislative and regulatory texts (finance laws and implementation decrees).
use.cndp: National identity card and employee number.
use.bkam: Payment rules and the central bank.
use.maroc: The national portal and the State's public services.

laws.cnss-recueil-rg: Employee contributions and social security regimes (the legal basis of every CNSS deduction).
laws.amo-loi-65-00: Basic compulsory health insurance (AMO) and reimbursement ceiling.
laws.amo-dahir: Latest amendment to the AMO regime (promulgating dahir).
laws.nma-2010: Economic activity nomenclature (NMA) — the activity basis in CNSS and DGI files.
laws.decret-2-04-512: Weekly rest (duration and exemptions) — used by the scheduling engine.
laws.decret-2-04-422: Work card and its mandatory entries — filled by HR.
laws.decret-2-04-513: Working conditions for women and minors — checked when validating schedules.
laws.decret-2-04-514: Company internal regulations — managed in company settings.
laws.decret-2-10-183: Collective relations, unions and trade-union representation — decides who signs for the company.
laws.bo-archives: Every Bulletin Officiel number with its publication date — the entry point to regulatory texts.

references.disclaimer: This page lists links to official sources only; the platform is not an official distributor and does not replace reading the original text or consulting a specialist.

deleteDialog.userDesc: The account and its memberships are deleted permanently and cannot be restored. A user with operational records (shifts, attendance or payroll) cannot be deleted — deactivate the account instead.
deleteDialog.companyDesc: The company and all its data (branches, projects, sites, shifts, attendance, payroll, documents) are deleted permanently and cannot be restored. You cannot delete the company active in your current session — switch to another company first.
deleteDialog.projectDesc: The project is deleted permanently and cannot be restored. A project with linked sites cannot be deleted — archive the sites first, or archive the project instead.
deleteDialog.siteDesc: The geographic site is deleted permanently and cannot be restored. A site with shifts or attendance records cannot be deleted — archive it instead to preserve the audit trail.
deleteDialog.branchDesc: The branch is deleted permanently and cannot be restored. A branch with projects or sites cannot be deleted — archive them first.
deleteDialog.reasonLabel: Deletion reason (optional — recorded in the audit log)
deleteDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. test account created for inspection
deleteDialog.typeName: Type {name} in the field to confirm deletion
deleteDialog.typeNameMismatch: The typed text does not match the company name — type it exactly
